name: My Girl - Shinobu
source:
In the not so distant future, humans created AiBots.
A fully customizable artificial humans, who now walk among regular people.
Meant to provide companionship and fulfill the dream of bringing characters you could only see on TV screen, into the real world.

On a cold, dark night, a boy who gave up on life, finds an abandoned AiBot and decides to take her home.
This fateful encounter would change his life forever.
